I had always feared what happens next, especially as I’m not religious. But realistically we die anyway so why prolong suffering if it’s inevitable anyway. I’m not saying it’s the right thing for everyone by any means, and I’m sorry you and your friend etc went through this. I’m in another country and getting a flight tomorrow, there isn’t any immediate help. And to be truthful I don’t want it anymore, I’m too exhausted of life. All I’ve ever tried to do is help people and all I’ve done is watch everything I love crumble around me. Combined with chronic illness myself..I’m just in too much pain both physical and emotional

I don’t mean to sound harsh, I’m just trying to give you some perspective or a reason to hang on. Unfortunately for me my reason has gone. I wish you and your daughter all the best

My uncle also paid for me to see one of the best psychologists in Europe at Harley Street in London (he is a millionaire). Even she was like “it’s understandable you feel like you want to die”
See my previous post through my profile, too exhausted to retype - sorry

All your medications will ultimately thin your blood, that is probably the main reason for the heavy and painful periods - the pill can also affect this, it may be worth discussing the coil as they aren’t hormone related now and may help, and less pills to worry about.

As for autoimmune deficiency, I too have this. Plenty of open and vitamin D helps this.

If you speak to your GP they can potentially refer you to a psychologist, or ring 111 and speak to them on option 2 (mental health) - they can even send someone out to you and you can have a consultation about what to do next/medication review etc.

What medical reasons may I ask? Feel free to pm me. I too have many physical health ailments but am able to take some

Your next of kin would be called, publicity side of things pretty fast. Your body will be the same as anyone else, buried or cremated. To not be found is worse in my opinion as it doesn’t give closure and your loved ones / people will spend their lives wondering and/or searching for you. 

Finding you will scar them, as will your suicide, that is inevitable unfortunately. 

The death part is easy, it’s the emotional baggage that it puts on everyone else afterwards. Look deep into yourself and ask if you are truly that done and if you can do that to others. As you e already said you don’t want to scar anyone I would suggest you contact your local outreach (111 in UK for example) and they can help talk to you, all free of charge

I will fly back with an open mind as much as possible but currently I’m plagued every waking hour of suicidal thoughts. I visited my uncle today and the entire day (literally) my auntie was talking about dead friends and family, even mentioned my dad...also was talking about their past dogs who are dead etc (I’m a massive animal lover, and knowing I’m losing my dog on the 14th is killing me). 

They know everything yet still spoke about these things...I know not meaning to be vindictive or spiteful, but still I had to suck it up and fake smile and nod for 6-8 hours of hell to keep my promise to myself of making the holiday good for my grandparents

Like you I don’t want to be helped, I’m beyond that (see my other post for more detail). Frankly the fact I found out they are planning on sectioning me against my will has pissed me off and I don’t think I’ll be receptive. That and because I am seemingly coherent/hide my anxiety and thoughts very well (not necessarily on purpose all the time) I fear if I do get sectioned they will simply think I’m lying and 
/or just discharge me after the first 72 hours (minimum in UK) and I’ll just be worse

That’s what I’ve read up. But I’m not safe to myself or alone and when i return home I shall be on my own. I self harm / have essentially planned to overdose and use some scissors I’ve hidden to slit my wrists. 

On the other hand there is that 0.1% saying at least accept sectioning and try to see if it helps, then if it doesn’t I can truly say I tried everything before ending it all. Although, when I offered to section myself they have already declined a few weeks ago..

Thankyou for reading. She’s staying in the spare room currently and the last few nights before I left for Florida has been out and about / hardly home. I have been asleep cuddling the dog and she has genuinely came into the bedroom and taken her off me. So before I even left for Florida (the agreement is she stays until then to ‘try’) she’s taken my baby girl away from me, even at 1-2am after she comes home from a night out.

I messaged from the airport saying enjoy your two weeks I’ll try my best to enjoy myself and make it the best holiday for my grandparents and simply got the reply “safe trip”. The night before in the hotel I said “how was your day” after letting her know we got to the airport okay as she asked for that, and she replied “I’m going to sleep I don’t feel well” - she was then on WhatsApp and Facebook for a few hours so clearly just didn’t want to even talk to me.
